prepared.describes: main after round B of the merge train (#606): the compatibility protocol (#594) and migration 18 (#602). Serves exactly schema 18, advertises operation_requirements, registers no operation.

successor.describes: The prepared release plus one change and no migration (the merge of the prepared commit into this change): roles may carry a description, and committing such a document is the registered operation policy.role_descriptions, gated on the policy_role_descriptions capability.
